qualifications_or_emphasis: Auditors' Qualification on standalone and consolidated financial statements

The compliance of the provisions of Corporate and other applicable laws, rules, regulations, standards is the responsibility of the management. Our examination was limited to the verification of procedures on test basis.
The Secretarial Audit report is neither an assurance as to the future viability of the company nor of the efficacy or effectiveness with which the management has conducted the affairs of the Company.
We have not verified the correctness and appropriateness of financial records and Books of Accounts of the Company.

The compliance by the Company of applicable financial laws, like direct and indirect tax laws, has not been reviewed in this Audit since the same have been subject to review by Statutory financial auditor and other designated professionals.

Basis for Qualified Opinion: No provision for impairment recognized for investment in GJS Hotels Limited (equity Rs. 860.86 Lakhs and loans Rs. 483.39 Lakhs) despite significant doubt on recoverability due to lease termination, bank guarantee forfeiture, and subsidiary's financial position. Had impairment been recognized, expenses would be higher by Rs. 1,344.25 Lakhs, net profit after tax reduced to Rs. 1,424.64 Lakhs from Rs. 2,768.89 Lakhs, total comprehensive income Rs. 1,428.65 Lakhs instead of Rs. 2,772.90 Lakhs, EPS Rs. 8.24 vs reported Rs. 16.01, other equity reduced by Rs. 1,344.25 Lakhs.

Emphasis of Matter: Recoverability of investment in and loans to Novak Hotels Private Limited (aggregating Rs. 24,928.50 Lakhs) substantially dependent on successful acquisition of Hyatt Regency Mumbai under Framework Agreement dated August 11, 2023, subject to resolution of competing claim, execution of loan/security documents, and discussions with Asian Hotels (West) Limited.
Backup of books of account and other books/papers maintained in electronic mode not maintained on servers physically located in India on daily basis.
Audit trail feature not operational in two accounting software applications; in another two applications, audit trail (edit log) facility at database level not enabled to record direct data changes.
Qualified opinion on standalone financial statements due to material weakness in internal control over impairment testing of investment in subsidiary GJS Hotels Limited.
Qualified opinion on internal financial controls due to material weakness in internal control process for impairment testing of investment in subsidiary GJS Hotels Limited.

No provision for impairment recognized in respect of investment in GJS Hotels Limited (equity shares Rs. 860.86 lakhs and loans Rs. 483.39 lakhs) despite events raising significant doubt regarding recoverability, which is not in accordance with Ind AS 36. outlook.statement: Novak Hotels Pvt Ltd commenced renovation/refurbishment work at Hyatt Regency Mumbai hotel project site; management expects to start hotel operations in the future.
GJS Hotels Ltd matter pending before Hon'ble High Court of Odisha; management hopeful of favourable outcome.

The outlook of hotel industry remains encouraging. The combination of limited supply, strengthening ADR and Kolkata's expanding appeal as both a cultural and commercial destination is expected to sustain growth momentum. However, diversification of offerings particularly in the social and events segment will be critical to mitigate seasonal variations and capture evolving consumer preferences.

The management feels its erosion is temporary in nature and the Company's future business plans and prospectus which help the Company to turn around its financial position and statement in future. The promoter of the Company has assured to infuse the funds as and when required.

Management has assessed the Company's liquidity and cash flow projections, including the expected refinancing/rollover of short-term borrowings, continued financial support from lenders, and the expected completion of the Hyatt Regency Mumbai acquisition. Based on these factors, management believes that the Company will be able to meet its obligations as they fall due and has accordingly prepared these financial statements on a going concern basis.
